name: CHAPSPaymentExecution
description: Records the full lifecycle of a CHAPS payment from RTGS submission through to settlement confirmation. Owned by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments, CAP-003). Contains ISO 20022 enhanced data mandatory fields: Purpose Code, LEI, UETR, structured address. Settlement is irrevocable once RTGS confirms.

fields.name: uetr
fields.validation_rule: ISO 20022 UETR. UUID v4 format. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: rtgs_message_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set after RTGS acceptance. Max 35 chars.

fields.name: beneficiary_sort_code
fields.validation_rule: 6-digit sort code XX-XX-XX. Validated via EISCD.

fields.name: beneficiary_iban
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Computed from sort code + account number.

fields.name: beneficiary_lei
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 17442. Mandatory for corporate beneficiaries from 1 May 2025.

fields.name: customer_cop_confirmation
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. confirmed_proceed | cancelled. Required for partial_match / no_match.

fields.name: sca_reference
fields.validation_rule: SVC-100 SCA challenge reference. PSR 2017 Reg 100.

fields.name: submission_status
fields.validation_rule: pending | submitted | accepted | rejected | settled | failed.

fields.name: submitted_at
fields.validation_rule: ISO 8601 UTC. Set when pacs.008 submitted.

fields.name: chaps_cutoff_missed
fields.validation_rule: Default false. Set true when cut-off passes before submission.

relationships.description: Debits one Account. Cross-capability CAP-003 → CAP-001 reference.
Conditional: linked to MortgageAccount when is_mortgage_completion_payment=true. Cross-capability.

design_decisions.rationale: CHAPS has mandatory ISO 20022 fields (purpose_code, LEI, UETR, RTGS ref) absent from FPS. Separate entity prevents sparse fields and facilitates CHAPS compliance evolution (GOV-003-R03 Phase 2).

design_decisions.decision: cop_result and customer_cop_confirmation stored on CHAPSPaymentExecution
design_decisions.rationale: CoP compliance evidence belongs in CAP-003 (payment execution record), not CAP-001 (payment intent).
